## 1. Executive Summary & Opportunity Hook
*What is the commercial opportunity in 2–3 sentences? Who pays us, why do they pay, and how much can this generate?*

---

## 2. Market Problem & Unmet Demand
* **The Industry Gap:** What is broken, inefficient, or unserved in the market today?
* **Why Incumbents Cannot Solve It:** Why can't Planning Center, Pushpay, Canvas, or FACTS address this?
* **Customer Willingness to Pay:** What evidence proves customers will pay for this?

---

## 3. ChurchCore Architectural Leverage (Existing Codebase Assets)
*How do our existing 517 database tables and 6 codebases give us an unfair advantage?*
- **Database Tables Leveraged:** [e.g., `audit_dossiers`, `ccm_checkin_sessions`, `funds`]
- **Frontend / Routes Leveraged:** [e.g., `/evaluator`, `/portal`, `/gradebook`]
- **Engineering Effort Required to Launch:** Minimal (1–2 weeks) | Moderate (1 month) | High (3+ months)

## 4. Monetization Mechanics & Financial Model
- **Revenue Model:** Per-Transaction % | Monthly SaaS Add-on | Annual Institutional License | Rev-Share
- **Pricing Schedule:** [e.g., $X / month or X% platform fee]
- **Unit Economics per Customer:** [Expected ARPU contribution]
- **Total Addressable Annual Revenue (ARR Potential):** [e.g., $500k – $5M ARR]

---

## 5. RICE Opportunity Scoring Rubric

$$\text{RICE Score} = \frac{\text{Reach} \times \text{Impact} \times \text{Confidence}}{\text{Effort}}$$

| Factor | Metric (1–10 Scale) | Rationale |
|---|:---:|---|
| **Reach (R)** | [1–10] | How many churches, schools, or users will this touch annually? |
| **Impact (I)** | [1–10] | How significantly does this increase ARR, LTV, or ministry retention? |
| **Confidence (C)** | [1–10] | How certain are we of market demand and technical feasibility? |
| **Effort (E)** | [1–10] | Engineering & operational friction required to deliver (1 = very low, 10 = huge). |
| **Composite Score** | **[Result]** | Normalized prioritization rank. |

---

## 6. Strategic Risks & Regulatory Invariants
- **Data Privacy & RLS Concerns:** Does this create cross-tenant leak risks?
- **Ministry Ethics & Confessional Neutrality:** Does this violate our Constitution?
- **Operational Drag:** Will this overwhelm our customer success or engineering teams?
